This is a Suo-moto case; Facts of the case are that the complainant Sri B. Venu Madhav, SIP stated that on 01.11.2023 at 17:00 hours, while he was conducting Vehicle Checking at Vikalangula Colony, Balajinagar, he found two persons suspiciously moving on Activa bike br.No TS08GE8903. On seeing the SI and staff, they tried to escape from the spot, however SI and staff caught the persons at 1715 hrs. Thereafter he informed the same to superior officers and secured two panchayathdars and briefed them to act as mediators. On enquiry they disclosed their names as 1) Tudumu Chitti Babu @ Chitti S/o Devaiah, age: 31 yrs, Occ: Painting, R/o; Santosh Nagar, Balajinagar, Kapra (M), Medchal (D). Cell: 8897459432, 2). crime_details.BRIEF_FACTS:
IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE XI ADDITIONAL CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE OF SECUNDERABAD.
HONOURED SIR,
The brief facts of the case are that on 01.01.2024 at 20:00 hours received a complaint from 1. S Raju, SI of Police, Bowenpally PS, Hyderabad, Phno: 8712660282. In which he stated that 01/01/2024 at about 16:00 hours he along with CAR-I staff ie., 1) Shivaraj, PC-9734, 2) John D'Souza, PC-30017, 3) Vinay, PC-30855 and 4) Yadagiri Goud, HG-5717 of Bowenpally PS was conducting area patrolling in the limits of PS Bowenpally. When they reached near HAL colony Park, RR Nagar Bus stop, Old Bowenpally they found two persons. One of them was carrying one blue cover and concealing their presence with bag on seeing the police. They caught them and when questioned about the bag, they started giving evasive replies and became panic. On further interrogation they revealed that the bag is containing Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja which they are taking to deliver to the customers. On enquiry they revealed their names as 1) Chandaluri Srinivasa Rao S/o Late Ch Venkateshwarlu, Chakali caste, 29 years, Process Associate at Amazon Hub, Shamshabad N/o Jarugumalli (v) Tanguturu mdl Prakasham district R/o H# 1-68/A, Old Hafeezpet, Miyapur and 2) Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years. Jangam caste R/o Omkareshwara Agency (Sanitary) near Mahankali Temple, Rani Gunj, Secunderabnad R/o H# 8-8-65, RR Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. Then he informed them that illegal possession and selling of Narcotics Drug is an offence under NDPS Act. Then, he sent PC-30017 to the PS with instructions to bring the laptop, mini printer along with weighing machine and stationary. Accordingly, the constable brought them. Meantime, he secured the presence of mediators 1) Debba Sammaiah S/o Chinnaiah, 31 years, Special RI, Tirumalagiri Tahasil Office R/o P# 38, Srinagar colony, Tirumalgiri, Hyderabad (7386255407) and 2) Torupunoori Ankush Kumar Goud S/o T Kumar, 32 years, business R/o H# 9-2-48/2, Royal Enclave, Hasmathpet, Old Bowenpally. They took power supply from Balajidev Narayan Mithai & Chat Bandar and in the presence of mediators he then recorded confessional statement of the accused A1 Chandaluri Srinivas Rao in presence of panchas, in which he stated that he was born and brought up in Hyderabad. In the year 2017 he completed his B Tech from Nitte Meenakshi Institute of Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka state. When his father expired in the year 2014 while he was pursuing B Tech, he felt loneliness and addicted to Ganja and Hashish oil. After the studies, he got a job at Sykes, Bangalore but after the first lock down he came to Hyderabad. He was continuously consuming Hashish Oil and Ganja by purchasing it from Kishore and Kalu of Dhoolpet. He got job in Amazon and was getting monthly salary of 35,000/-. He along with his friend Vinod visited Lambasingi (tourist place) of East Godavari district, purchased Hashish Oil from one Sandeep of Chitapally, Annavaram. On 14/08/2020, he married Smt Aparna but his earnings were not sufficient to lead the family. As he knew there is heavy demand in Hyderabad for the Hashish Oil, he hatched a plan to procure the Hashish Oil from Sandeep and to sell it to needy customers at inflated price to make easy money. As per his plan, for last two years, he was procuring Hashish Oil from Sandeep at 57,000/- per One Kilogram packed in small plastic containers of 5 Grams each and sold it to the needy customers at 2,000/- each container. In the month of June 2023, he was arrested by Qutbullapur Excise police under NDPS Act. He got acquainted to Ranjith Kumar through a common friend Nitish. Ranjith is also addicted to Ganja consumption. After few days, Ranjith informed that he was also selling Ganja to needy customers. On that he offered commission to Ranjith if he assisted in the sale of Hashish Oil for which he has readily agreed and joined hands with him. Then they both procured Hashish Oil from Sandeep and sold to the needy customers. On asking about his customers, he opened his iPhone-13 and showed customers name and cell number in his contact list as 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515. On 22/12/2023 they both went to Lambasinge and met Sandeep and procured one Kilogram of Hashish Oil paying 57,000/- and transported it to Hyderabad and retained it in his house for later disposal. Today i.e., on 01/01/2024 evening after Ranjith came to him, both of them left with Hashish Oil to pack it in small plastic containers at the house of Ranjith at RR Nagar. When they reached the HAL colony park they were apprehended. Then he produced the plastic bag containing the Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja. On weighing, it is found weighing (1025) grams. The same was put in another plastic cover, pasted with adhesive tape, and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, and pasted and sealed with Lakka with Police Station seal and marked as P-1. He also produced one Apple make iPhone 13 model. It was put in another zip lock cover and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-2. Later he have recorded confessional statement of the another person A2 Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years, Jangam caste R/o Omkareshwara Agency (Sanitary) near Mahankali Temple, Rani Gunj, Secunderabnad R/o H.no: 8-8-65, RR Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. He has confessed the offence as confessed by the first accused and also disclosed that he was arrested by police in two cases in the past in Ghatkesar and Nacharam PS under NDPS Act cases. Then he produced one Realme make cell phone. It was put in another zip lock cover and it was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-3. Since they were not carrying anything in their personal possession, the service of Gazetted officer is not taken. The supplier of Hashish Oil namely Sandeep of Chintapally, Annavaram, AP State and consumers/customers 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515 are absconding. Hence he is producing the above said two persons along with the seized property for necessary action.

crime_details.BRIEF_FACTS:
IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE XI ADDITIONAL CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE OF SECUNDERABAD.
HONOURED SIR,
The brief facts of the case are that on 01.01.2024 at 20:00 hours received a complaint from 1. S Raju, SI of Police, Bowenpally PS, Hyderabad, Phno: 8712660282. In which he stated that 01/01/2024 at about 16:00 hours he along with CAR-I staff ie., 1) Shivaraj, PC-9734, 2) John D'Souza, PC-30017, 3) Vinay, PC-30855 and 4) Yadagiri Goud, HG-5717 of Bowenpally PS was conducting area patrolling in the limits of PS Bowenpally. When they reached near HAL colony Park, RR Nagar Bus stop, Old Bowenpally they found two persons. One of them was carrying one blue cover and concealing their presence with bag on seeing the police. They caught them and when questioned about the bag, they started giving evasive replies and became panic. On further interrogation they revealed that the bag is containing Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja which they are taking to deliver to the customers. On enquiry they revealed their names as 1) Chandaluri Srinivasa Rao S/o Late Ch Venkateshwarlu, Chakali caste, 29 years, Process Associate at Amazon Hub, Shamshabad N/o Jarugumalli (v) Tanguturu mdl Prakasham district R/o H# 1-68/A, Old Hafeezpet, Miyapur and 2) Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years. Jangam caste R/o Omkareshwara Agency (Sanitary) near Mahankali Temple, Rani Gunj, Secunderabnad R/o H# 8-8-65, RR Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. Then he informed them that illegal possession and selling of Narcotics Drug is an offence under NDPS Act. Then, he sent PC-30017 to the PS with instructions to bring the laptop, mini printer along with weighing machine and stationary. Accordingly, the constable brought them. Meantime, he secured the presence of mediators 1) Debba Sammaiah S/o Chinnaiah, 31 years, Special RI, Tirumalagiri Tahasil Office R/o P# 38, Srinagar colony, Tirumalgiri, Hyderabad (7386255407) and 2) Torupunoori Ankush Kumar Goud S/o T Kumar, 32 years, business R/o H# 9-2-48/2, Royal Enclave, Hasmathpet, Old Bowenpally. They took power supply from Balajidev Narayan Mithai & Chat Bandar and in the presence of mediators he then recorded confessional statement of the accused A1 Chandaluri Srinivas Rao in presence of panchas, in which he stated that he was born and brought up in Hyderabad. In the year 2017 he completed his B Tech from Nitte Meenakshi Institute of Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka state. When his father expired in the year 2014 while he was pursuing B Tech, he felt loneliness and addicted to Ganja and Hashish oil. After the studies, he got a job at Sykes, Bangalore but after the first lock down he came to Hyderabad. He was continuously consuming Hashish Oil and Ganja by purchasing it from Kishore and Kalu of Dhoolpet. He got job in Amazon and was getting monthly salary of 35,000/-. He along with his friend Vinod visited Lambasingi (tourist place) of East Godavari district, purchased Hashish Oil from one Sandeep of Chitapally, Annavaram. On 14/08/2020, he married Smt Aparna but his earnings were not sufficient to lead the family. As he knew there is heavy demand in Hyderabad for the Hashish Oil, he hatched a plan to procure the Hashish Oil from Sandeep and to sell it to needy customers at inflated price to make easy money. As per his plan, for last two years, he was procuring Hashish Oil from Sandeep at 57,000/- per One Kilogram packed in small plastic containers of 5 Grams each and sold it to the needy customers at 2,000/- each container. In the month of June 2023, he was arrested by Qutbullapur Excise police under NDPS Act. He got acquainted to Ranjith Kumar through a common friend Nitish. Ranjith is also addicted to Ganja consumption. After few days, Ranjith informed that he was also selling Ganja to needy customers. On that he offered commission to Ranjith if he assisted in the sale of Hashish Oil for which he has readily agreed and joined hands with him. Then they both procured Hashish Oil from Sandeep and sold to the needy customers. On asking about his customers, he opened his iPhone-13 and showed customers name and cell number in his contact list as 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515. On 22/12/2023 they both went to Lambasinge and met Sandeep and procured one Kilogram of Hashish Oil paying 57,000/- and transported it to Hyderabad and retained it in his house for later disposal. Today i.e., on 01/01/2024 evening after Ranjith came to him, both of them left with Hashish Oil to pack it in small plastic containers at the house of Ranjith at RR Nagar. When they reached the HAL colony park they were apprehended. Then he produced the plastic bag containing the Hashish Oil extracted from Ganja. On weighing, it is found weighing (1025) grams. The same was put in another plastic cover, pasted with adhesive tape, and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, and pasted and sealed with Lakka with Police Station seal and marked as P-1. He also produced one Apple make iPhone 13 model. It was put in another zip lock cover and the same was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-2. Later he have recorded confessional statement of the another person A2 Akaram Ranjith Kumar S/o Akaram Mallesh, 28 years, Jangam caste R/o Omkareshwara Agency (Sanitary) near Mahankali Temple, Rani Gunj, Secunderabnad R/o H.no: 8-8-65, RR Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. He has confessed the offence as confessed by the first accused and also disclosed that he was arrested by police in two cases in the past in Ghatkesar and Nacharam PS under NDPS Act cases. Then he produced one Realme make cell phone. It was put in another zip lock cover and it was put in a gauge cloth cover, pasted, sealed with Lakka and police station seal and marked as P-3. Since they were not carrying anything in their personal possession, the service of Gazetted officer is not taken. The supplier of Hashish Oil namely Sandeep of Chintapally, Annavaram, AP State and consumers/customers 1) Srinivas cell No 9989059533; 2) Nagoor, Cell No 9703201506; 3) Shannu, Cell No 9959023243; 4) Abhishek Cell No 8106001865; and 5) Akshay, Cell No 9381244515 are absconding. Hence he is producing the above said two persons along with the seized property for necessary action.

Sd/-

This is a Suo-moto case; Facts of the case are that the complainant Sri B. Venu Madhav, SIP stated that on 01.11.2023 at 17:00 hours, while he was conducting Vehicle Checking at Vikalangula Colony, Balajinagar, he found two persons suspiciously moving on Activa bike br.No TS08GE8903. On seeing the SI and staff, they tried to escape from the spot, however SI and staff caught the persons at 1715 hrs. Later SI and Staff searched the bike and found 250 gms of Dry Ganja in the dickey of the bike. Thereafter he informed the same to superior officers and secured two panchayathdars and briefed them to act as mediators. On enquiry they disclosed their names as 1) Tudumu Chitti Babu @ Chitti S/o Devaiah, age: 31 yrs, Occ: Painting, R/o; Santosh Nagar, Balajinagar, Kapra (M), Medchal (D). Cell: 8897459432, 2).
